summary: The fewest elements that do the job. Everything left on the page has to justify being there.
source: Tilda Minimalism + 2025 trends · Looka §3 · dev.to §5 · Dieter Rams, Ten principles (Vitsoe, CC-BY-NC-ND)

ground.role: near-white, not #fff — white is a colour choice too

grey.role: secondary text. CONTRAST separates levels, not size

accent.role: ONE accent, used ONCE per view

radius.note: 0, or one small value applied everywhere

shadow.rule: spacing separates things; shadows are a second system doing the same job

spacing.note: one ratio, and use the LARGE end

type.rule: weight 300 for 24px+ ONLY — light weights read as low-contrast at small sizes

focus.reason: the accent is used once per view and cannot be spent on a focus ring; ink on ground is 17.4:1

copyBudget.headlineReason: a minimal page has one statement; six words is already generous
copyBudget.note: the LOWEST budget in the catalogue. Emptiness is the style working, not a gap to fill.

a11y.affordanceWarning: Minimalism hides affordances. A button that is just text with no border and no fill gets missed. Every interactive element needs at least one NON-COLOUR signal.
a11y.greyWarning: #7a7a7a on #fafafa is ~4.6:1 — fine for 16px body, NOT fine below 14px. This pack uses #6b6b6b (5.9:1) to buy headroom.
a11y.targetSizeNote: Bare text links in this pack land at 23.99px tall (15px x 1.6) - 0.01px under the 24x24 floor of WCAG 2.5.8. Nav links carry 6px vertical padding for that reason alone. Caught by the self-audit, not by eye.

banned: decorative dividers, badges, ribbons, gradient fills
drop shadows used to separate things that spacing could separate
icons next to labels that already say the same thing
more than two type sizes in a section
filling whitespace because it looks empty — that is the style working

darkMode.note: Inverts cleanly because there is almost nothing to invert. Ground #0f0f0f, ink #f0f0f0, grey #9a9a9a (6.3:1).

scroll.headline: scroll-reveal (●)
scroll.reason: The rule is not WHICH technique, it is HOW MANY. One for the whole page, opacity-led with short travel. 22px and a 6% stagger is the ceiling — past that it stops being restraint and becomes an effect.
banned: scroll-marquee — perpetual motion in a style built on stillness

sheet.metaLine: #fafafa ground · 300 weight display · one accent, once · 96–160px sections
tokenTable: light weight below 24px reads as low contrast
the measure does the work of a decoration

notes.tokens: Rams #10, and the pack's whole thesis: “Good design is as little design as possible.” This is a spacing and restraint system, not a decoration system.
notes.nav: Text links and one rule. No bar, no fill, no shadow — the header is separated by space, not by a container.
notes.hero: One statement, one supporting line, one action. Four text elements is the ceiling and this uses three. Weight 300 is safe here because the display size is well above 24px.
notes.button: This is the pack's weak point and the state floor forces the fix. A text-only button gets missed, so the primary carries a fill and the secondary carries a 1px rule — a non-colour signal on both, per the affordance warning.
notes.form: A field is a bottom rule, not a box. The error is text plus a mark — the accent is already spent, so red is not available as a signal here.
notes.card: There is no card. Content sits on the ground, separated by space. The specimen shows the only permitted container: a 1px hairline, no fill, no shadow.
notes.table: Where minimalism is quietly excellent — rules at 1px, generous row padding, no zebra, no borders on the outside.
notes.overlay: A flat scrim and a plain panel. No blur, no shadow. The panel is identified by its ground, not by elevation.
notes.empty: The one state where emptiness is a problem rather than the style. It needs a statement and an action, or it reads as a broken page.
notes.dark: Inverts cleanly because there is almost nothing to invert. Secondary grey moves to #9a9a9a (6.3:1) — #6b6b6b on a dark ground would be 3.1:1 and fail body text.
notes.narrow: Section padding compresses from 160px to 48px, but never below — the space is the design. Measure stays capped at 34ch minimum so lines do not become too short.
notes.copy: 240 chars per viewport — the lowest budget in the catalogue, against the engine's 420.
